-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies API key and connectivity to ElevenLabs.

text-to-speech.name: text-to-speech
text-to-speech.description: Generate speech from text using ElevenLabs. Returns the audio file path. Use the default voice (do not specify voiceId) unless the user explicitly requests a different voice.

params.text: The text to convert to speech
params.voiceId: Voice ID to use. Use list_voices to see available voices. Default: Marianne Muller (Spanish)
params.modelId: Model to use: eleven_monolingual_v1, eleven_multilingual_v1, eleven_multilingual_v2, eleven_turbo_v2, eleven_turbo_v2_5, eleven_flash_v2_5 (default)
params.stability: Voice stability (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.5). Higher = more stable/consistent
params.similarityBoost: Similarity boost (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.75). Higher = closer to original voice
params.style: Style exaggeration (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0). Higher = more expressive
params.speakerBoost: Enable speaker boost for better quality (default: true)
params.outputPath: Custom output path for the audio file (optional). Defaults to /workspace/tts-{timestamp}.mp3

list-voices.name: list-voices
list-voices.description: List available voices from ElevenLabs account. Supports filtering by name, category, and limiting results.

params.search: Search term to filter voices by name (case-insensitive, optional)
params.limit: Maximum number of voices to return (optional, default: all)
params.category: Filter by voice category: premade, cloned, generated, professional (optional)

get-voice.name: get-voice
get-voice.description: Get detailed information about a specific voice including settings and samples.

params.voiceId: The ID of the voice to get information about

generate-conversation.name: generate-conversation
generate-conversation.description: Generate a multi-speaker conversation from a YAML script. Reads a YAML file with speaker voices and dialogue, generates audio for each line, and combines them into a single audio file. Requires ffmpeg installed.

params.scriptPath: Path to the YAML script file (absolute or relative to current directory)

get-subscription.name: get-subscription
get-subscription.description: Get information about the current ElevenLabs subscription including character usage and limits.

list-phone-numbers.name: list-phone-numbers
list-phone-numbers.description: List phone numbers connected to ElevenLabs with their assigned agent and capabilities.

import-twilio-number.name: import-twilio-number
import-twilio-number.description: Import a Twilio phone number into ElevenLabs for inbound and outbound agent calls.

params.label: Descriptive label
params.twilioSid: Twilio Account SID (AC...) or API Key SID (SK...)
params.twilioToken: Twilio Auth Token or API Key Secret

outbound-call.name: outbound-call
outbound-call.description: Make an outbound phone call from a connected ElevenLabs number using an agent. The agent starts the conversation when the recipient answers.

params.toNumber: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +34600123456)
params.agentId: Optional agent ID. Defaults to Teros Voice Agent
params.phoneNumberId: Optional phone_number_id of the caller number. Defaults to the first connected number
params.firstMessage: Optional first message override for this call
params.dynamicVariables: Optional dynamic variables passed to the agent
params.notifyChannel: Notify the initiating channel when the call ends (one-time post-call subscription). Default: true. Set false for fire-and-forget calls.

get-conversation.name: get-conversation
get-conversation.description: Get details of an ElevenLabs conversation (transcript, analysis, status) by its ID.

get-agent.name: get-agent
get-agent.description: Get the full configuration of an ElevenLabs ConvAI agent (name, first message, system prompt, ASR keywords, tools, phone numbers, metadata). If agentId is omitted, uses the AGENT_ID system secret (Teros Voice Agent by default).

params.agentId: Optional ElevenLabs agent ID (e.g. agent_8101kb0xa4jje0s963kw6nhfmdh7). Defaults to the AGENT_ID system secret.

update-agent.name: update-agent
update-agent.description: Update an ElevenLabs ConvAI agent configuration. Partial merge: only the fields you pass are modified — tools, TTS, phone numbers, and the rest of the conversation_config stay intact. Use get-agent first to inspect the current state. If agentId is omitted, uses the AGENT_ID system secret.

params.agentId: Optional ElevenLabs agent ID. Defaults to the AGENT_ID system secret (Teros Voice Agent).
params.name: New display name for the agent.
params.firstMessage: New first message (the opening line the agent speaks when the call connects). Maps to conversation_config.agent.first_message.
params.systemPrompt: New system prompt. Maps to conversation_config.agent.prompt.prompt. Keep the {{call_context}} placeholder if you want per-call context to keep working.
params.asrKeywords: New ASR keyword list (replaces the existing one). Maps to conversation_config.asr.keywords. Pass an empty array to clear.

name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs voice app — generate natural-sounding speech from text (TTS) and make phone calls with a conversational voice agent (outbound calls via Twilio, call transcripts and analysis, ConvAI agent configuration).

changelog.notes: Initial release — turn text into natural speech, browse and inspect AI voices, build multi-speaker conversations, and track plan usage
